name: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A classic American novel set in the Jazz Age, exploring themes of wealth, love, and the American Dream through the story of Jay Gatsby's pursuit of Daisy Buchanan.

name: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A gripping tale of racial injustice and childhood innocence in the American South, told through the eyes of Scout Finch.

name: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An accessible exploration of cosmology, black holes, and the nature of time and space by one of the world's greatest physicists.

name: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
description: Ancient Chinese military treatise offering timeless strategies and wisdom applicable to warfare, business, and life.

name: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A witty and romantic novel about Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy, exploring themes of love, class, and social expectations.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopian masterpiece depicting a totalitarian society where independent thought is criminalized.

name: The Origin of Species
author: Charles Darwin
description: Groundbreaking scientific work that introduced the theory of evolution and natural selection.

name: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
description: Personal reflections of the Roman Emperor on Stoic philosophy, virtue, and the nature of human existence.

name: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
description: The story of an orphaned governess who faces hardship and finds love, embodying themes of independence and equality.

name: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
description: A passionate and turbulent tale of love and revenge set on the Yorkshire moors.
